name: NdefDiscovered
summary: Argument passed to the callback when an NDEF message, tag, or technology is discovered.

properties.name: action
properties.summary: Identifies the action from the intent.
properties.description:
This value will be one of the constants defined on the [Modules.Nfc](api:Modules.Nfc) module object (ACTION_NDEF_DISCOVERED, ACTION_TAG_DISCOVERED, or
ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED).

properties.name: error
properties.summary: The error code returned if an error occurred while reading the tag.

properties.name: messsages
properties.summary: Array of NDEF messages parsed from the tag.

properties.name: tag
properties.summary: NFC tag proxy identifying the tag was was discovered.
